notes.title: The GLITCH DADDY teaser demo is out!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I just got a teaser demo for the upcoming [b]GLITCH DADDY[/b] out.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2676440/Glitch_Daddy/

It is a short one, clocking at around ~10-15 minutes, and it is essentially the intro level from the main game, a dream our protagonists has just before the main story starts taking place (think of it as a little showcase of aesthetics, along with a few of the basic mechanics).

I decided to keep it there, since I believe it is pretty neat and specific aesthetics and style-wise. Of course the game takes several left-field turns after that, but you can now have a first taste of it. :)

So tune in for [b]GLITCH DADDY[/b], and please spread the word if you enjoy it.
I hope you will

xx
SAD MASK PARTY

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LVyNP6c.png[/img]

notes.title: Announcing GLITCH DADDY!
notes.notes:
Hey guys,
[b]Sad Mask Party[/b] here...
there's a new game in the works, and it's coming to you sooner than you think.
I'm very excited to announce that the store page for [b]GLITCH DADDY[/b] is now live on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2676440/Glitch_Daddy

It is a first person adventure, featuring atmospheric exploration, puzzles, some fun action sequences and fights, interactive dialogue, deconstructed psychology, weird vibes and an equal mixture of horror(ish) and humorous elements. The graphics are PS1-inspired, but with a healthy dose of surrealism and liminality.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EQDBjtb.png[/img]

The story starts through a dream where you meet [b]Glitch Daddy[/b], a strange creature informing you about the world's end coming really, really soon. You go on to wake up, and embark on a wild journey where the truth will be revealed, through a series of weird, unexpected twists and turns.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dKbLfZr.png[/img]

Drenched in a thick vibe of nostalgia, [b]Glitch Daddy[/b] seamlessly jumps from the memories of an ideal childhood, to a complicated adulthood, and the cosmic, deconstructed dreamscapes of a timeless oblivion.

Also, you can kill monsters and pet doggos. ;)

More exciting news on this coming very soon. In the meantime, feel free to wishlist.

notes.title: The Lotus Holidays is finally OUT!
notes.notes:
[h1]SURPRISE!!![/h1]
After what has been quite a rollercoaster of a year, I am very excited and proud to announce that 
[b]The Lotus Holidays[/b] is finally out for you guys to play and immerse yourself in it!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/D19XHZZ/The-Lotus-Holidays-Hgv-Hd61-RAP.jpg[/img]

It is a stylish single player story-based game, where you win a free weekend at the "Lotus", a luxurious spa resort. But soon, things take a strange and sinister turn.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/F5Wqw33/The-Lotus-Holidays-Y7-UCRx-V5-ZOa.jpg[/img]

It features lots of characters, choices, endings, wild sights (and outfits), and an intricate, interactive story that can unfold in many unexpected ways, given the choices you make and the relationships you build (or not).
It's presented as a neo-noir with sci-fi elements, but ultimately it's a deeply personal tale, holding quite a gut-punch and exciting surprises for those who will stick around to the end.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/4MHLGCF/The-Lotus-Holidays-9-SMxg-Y9mp-X.jpg[/img]

I hope you enjoy it. 
XX

PS: The original soundtrack will also be available very soon.
